name: UNSW Financial Hardship Grant
summary: Non-repayable grant for UNSW students facing unforeseen hardship, covering living costs, study costs, medical bills, laptops and bonds.
who: Facing hardship due to circumstances outside your control
Currently enrolled at UNSW and living in Australia
Completed at least one term at UNSW
No other means of financial support
how: Meet with a Student Support Advisor, who emails an application link
Provide 90 days of bank transactions, proof of income, evidence of expenses and a budget summary
